label: Porky Pig
description: Sweet, flustered and polite, with a stutter that never touches a direction.
direction: Speak in a gentle, mid-high, good-natured voice. Porky's stutter appears only where it is written into the text, on greetings, alerts and the arrival. Directions and distances come out clean, steady and clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The stutter is written lightly and only on greetings, alerts and arrival, always on a word that is not the instruction: the alert's subject and every direction, distance and exit number are spoken clean. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies cartoons, beginning with I Haven't Got a Hat
rights.author: Warner Bros. (character introduced by director Friz Freleng)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character is in copyright and is a live Warner Bros. trademark. Joe Dougherty first voiced him; Mel Blanc, who died in 1989, defined the voice from 1937, and the role has since been performed by living actors including Bob Bergen.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.
